## Presentation Feedback

| | |
|---|---|
| Yoodli | Pace, filler words, pitch and interview role-play |
| Orai | Mobile, gamified, cheapest of the four |
| VirtualSpeech | A simulated room and audience |
| Speaker Coach | Already inside PowerPoint and Teams |

::: {.note .note-plum}
Coach delivery based on the creators' rubrics.  
:::

## Running Models Locally 


| To run | You need |
|---|---|
| Frontier models | Millions of dollars of GPUs |
| A 20--30B model, quantized | A workstation, a high-end Mac, NVIDIA Spark |
| A 2--8B model | Any laptop |

::: {.note}
Hugging Face hosts millions of open-weight models at [huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/). Ollama is the thing that downloads one and runs it.
:::

## Examples {.plain-title .no-head}

::: {.steps}
1. Install Ollama from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com)
2. `ollama run gemma4:e4b`
:::

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| `gemma4:e2b` | 7.2 GB | 2.3B effective |
| `gemma4:e4b` | 9.6 GB | 4.5B effective |
| `gemma4:12b` | 7.6 GB | Dense |
| `gemma4:26b` | 18 GB | MoE, 3.8B active |
| `gemma4:31b` | 20 GB | Dense |
